mcp-atlassian.description: Jira + Confluence access (sooperset/mcp-atlassian, run via uvx) for ticket ingestion and doc/handoff publishing. Uses OAuth 2.0 BYOT (bring-your-own-token) auth for Atlassian Cloud instead of username+API-token basic auth. ATLASSIAN_OAUTH_CLOUD_ID is Vincit's cloud ID (not a secret, safe to commit). JIRA_PROJECTS_FILTER, CONFLUENCE_SPACES_FILTER, and READ_ONLY_MODE are hardcoded Vincit-wide constants, same as before. ATLASSIAN_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN is the actual secret — NEVER stored in config or committed files; set it as a real environment variable in your own shell/profile. Token refresh is the user's responsibility — BYOT tokens are not auto-refreshed by the server, so this needs periodic re-export as the token expires.
